title: Tigerair Taiwan Launches a Plane Covered in National Palace Museum Treasures
summaryZh: 台灣虎航故宮聯名彩繪機19日首航福岡，機身印富春山居圖與翠玉白菜。
summaryHi: टाइगरएयर ताइवान का नेशनल पैलेस म्यूज़ियम थीम वाला विमान गुरुवार को फुकुओका के लिए पहली उड़ान पर गया।
summaryEs: Tigerair Taiwan estrena un avión decorado con tesoros del Museo del Palacio Nacional en su primer vuelo a Fukuoka.
summaryJa: タイガーエア台湾の故宮博物院コラボ機が19日に福岡へ初就航。富春山居図や翠玉白菜を描く。
summaryKo: 타이거에어 타이완의 고궁박물원 협업 항공기가 19일 후쿠오카로 첫 운항했다. 부춘산거도와 취옥백채가 그려졌다.
summaryEn: Tigerair Taiwan's new plane decorated with National Palace Museum treasures made its first flight to Fukuoka on Thursday.
paragraphs: Travellers flying with Tigerair Taiwan may now find themselves on board a work of art. The budget airline has unveiled an Airbus A320neo covered in images of treasures from the National Palace Museum, and the jet made its first commercial flight to Fukuoka, Japan, on Thursday.

The aircraft's background is based on Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains, an ink scroll painted by Huang Gongwang during the Yuan dynasty. Very few of the artist's works survive today, which makes the painting especially precious. Nine other pieces from the museum's collection are also displayed, among them the popular Jadeite Cabbage and Meat-Shaped Stone.

At a media event in the airline's hangar on Wednesday, chairperson Huang Shih-hui pointed out the city's special link with the museum. In October 2014, the Kyushu National Museum in Fukuoka Prefecture became the first museum in Japan to exhibit artefacts from Taiwan's National Palace Museum.

Flight IT240 left Taoyuan International Airport at 6:45 in the morning and was scheduled to arrive at 10 o'clock local time. As part of the partnership, the airline is selling co-branded souvenirs such as model aircraft, and passengers who show a Tigerair Taiwan boarding pass at the museum will receive 10 percent off admission.
Tigerair Taiwan has a new plane with famous art on it. The art comes from the National Palace Museum in Taipei.
The plane shows mountains from an old Chinese painting. It also shows nine other famous objects. Two of them are the Jadeite Cabbage and the Meat-Shaped Stone.
The first flight with the new plane was on Thursday morning. It left Taoyuan Airport at 6:45 and flew to Fukuoka in Japan.
Why Fukuoka? In 2014, a museum there was the first in Japan to show art from the National Palace Museum.
There are also model planes and other gifts to buy. If you show your Tigerair boarding pass at the museum, you get 10 percent off the ticket.

飛機上畫著一幅中國古畫裡的山。
它也展示了另外九件有名的文物。
其中兩件是翠玉白菜和肉形石。
這架新飛機的第一個航班在週四早上。
它在 6:45 從桃園機場起飛，飛往日本福岡。
為什麼是福岡？
2014 年，那裡的一家博物館是日本第一個展出故宮文物的博物館。
也有模型飛機和其他紀念品可以買。
如果你在博物館出示台灣虎航的登機證，門票可以打九折。

paragraphs: Tigerair Taiwan has started flying a plane decorated with treasures from the National Palace Museum. The Airbus A320neo made its first flight on Thursday, from Taoyuan Airport to Fukuoka in Japan.

The background of the design shows mountains from Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains, a famous painting by Huang Gongwang from the Yuan dynasty. Nine other objects from the museum also appear on the plane, including the Jadeite Cabbage and the Meat-Shaped Stone.

The airline's chairperson, Huang Shih-hui, explained why the first flight went to Fukuoka. In 2014, the Kyushu National Museum there became the first museum in Japan to show items from the National Palace Museum.
Flight IT240 left Taoyuan at 6:45 in the morning and was due to land in Fukuoka at 10 o'clock local time.
The partnership also includes souvenirs such as model planes. Passengers who show a Tigerair Taiwan boarding pass at the museum will get a 10 percent discount on entry.

飛機上也出現博物館的另外九件文物，包括翠玉白菜和肉形石。
航空公司董事長黃世惠解釋了首航為何飛往福岡。
2014 年，當地的九州國立博物館成為日本第一個展出故宮文物的博物館。
IT240 航班於早上 6:45 從桃園起飛，預計當地時間 10 點降落福岡。
這項合作也包括模型飛機等紀念品。
在博物館出示台灣虎航登機證的旅客，入場可享九折優惠。

The aircraft's background is based on Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains, an ink scroll painted by Huang Gongwang during the Yuan dynasty. Very few of the artist's works survive today, which makes the painting especially precious. Nine other pieces from the museum's collection are also displayed, among them the popular Jadeite Cabbage and Meat-Shaped Stone.

At a media event in the airline's hangar on Wednesday, chairperson Huang Shih-hui pointed out the city's special link with the museum. In October 2014, the Kyushu National Museum in Fukuoka Prefecture became the first museum in Japan to exhibit artefacts from Taiwan's National Palace Museum.

Flight IT240 left Taoyuan International Airport at 6:45 in the morning and was scheduled to arrive at 10 o'clock local time. sentZh: 搭乘台灣虎航的旅客現在可能會發現自己坐在一件藝術品上。
這家廉價航空公布了一架印滿故宮國寶圖像的空中巴士 A320neo，這架噴射機週四首次執行飛往日本福岡的商業航班。
飛機的背景取材自元代黃公望所繪的水墨長卷〈富春山居圖〉。
這位畫家流傳至今的作品極少，使這幅畫格外珍貴。
博物館館藏的另外九件作品也展示在機身上，其中包括廣受歡迎的翠玉白菜和肉形石。
週三在航空公司機棚舉行的媒體活動上，董事長黃世惠指出這座城市與故宮的特殊淵源。
2014 年 10 月，福岡縣的九州國立博物館成為日本第一個展出台灣故宮文物的博物館。
IT240 航班於上午 6:45 從桃園國際機場起飛，預定當地時間 10 點抵達。
作為合作的一部分，航空公司販售模型飛機等聯名紀念品，旅客在博物館出示台灣虎航登機證即可享門票九折。

paragraphs: Taiwan's best-known museum treasures have taken to the skies. Tigerair Taiwan's new co-branded Airbus A320neo, wrapped in artwork from the National Palace Museum, operated its inaugural commercial service to Fukuoka on Thursday.

The livery is built around the jagged peaks of Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains, a Yuan-dynasty ink handscroll by Huang Gongwang, one of the few works by the master that have survived. Superimposed on this landscape are nine further highlights of the collection, including the much-loved Jadeite Cabbage and the uncannily realistic Meat-Shaped Stone.

Speaking during a media tour of the hangar on Wednesday, chairperson Huang Shih-hui highlighted the historical resonance of the destination. In October 2014, she noted, the Kyushu National Museum became the first institution in Japan to host exhibits from the National Palace Museum.

Flight IT240 departed Taoyuan at 6:45 in the morning, with arrival in Fukuoka scheduled for 10 o'clock local time. Beyond the aircraft itself, the tie-up features branded merchandise, including scale models, along with a 10 percent admission discount at the museum for anyone presenting a Tigerair Taiwan boarding pass.
sentZh: 台灣最知名的博物館國寶飛上了天空。
台灣虎航全新的聯名空中巴士 A320neo 以故宮藝術品包覆機身，週四執行飛往福岡的首航商業班機。
這款塗裝以〈富春山居圖〉中嶙峋的山峰為主軸，這幅元代水墨手卷出自黃公望之手，是這位大師少數傳世的作品之一。
在這幅山水之上，還疊加了另外九件館藏精品，包括備受喜愛的翠玉白菜和逼真得不可思議的肉形石。
董事長黃世惠週三在機棚媒體參訪時發言，強調了這個目的地的歷史意義。
她指出，2014 年 10 月，九州國立博物館成為日本第一個展出故宮文物的機構。
IT240 航班上午 6:45 從桃園起飛，預定當地時間 10 點抵達福岡。
除了飛機本身，這項合作還推出聯名商品，包括比例模型；凡出示台灣虎航登機證者，參觀故宮可享門票九折。

paragraphs: In an unusual fusion of aviation and heritage, Tigerair Taiwan has launched an aircraft decorated with masterpieces from the National Palace Museum. The Airbus A320neo made its maiden commercial flight, from Taoyuan to Fukuoka, on Thursday morning.

The design draws on Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains, a celebrated Yuan-dynasty handscroll by Huang Gongwang, whose surviving output is extremely limited. Nine additional artefacts feature prominently on the fuselage, notably the iconic Jadeite Cabbage and the Meat-Shaped Stone, objects that attract long queues of visitors in Taipei.

Chairperson Huang Shih-hui emphasised the symbolic significance of the route. In 2014, the Kyushu National Museum in Fukuoka became the first venue in Japan to exhibit pieces from the National Palace Museum, a landmark moment in cultural exchange between the two neighbours.

Commercially, the collaboration extends well beyond the aircraft. Co-branded merchandise, including model planes, is on sale, and passengers presenting a Tigerair Taiwan boarding pass are entitled to a 10 percent reduction on museum admission.
Partnerships of this kind can help cultural institutions reach younger and international audiences.
sentZh: 台灣虎航以航空與文化遺產的罕見結合，推出一架以故宮傑作裝飾的飛機。
這架空中巴士 A320neo 於週四上午執行從桃園飛往福岡的首次商業飛行。
這款設計取材自黃公望著名的元代手卷〈富春山居圖〉，黃公望傳世的作品極為有限。
另外九件文物顯眼地出現在機身上，尤其是具代表性的翠玉白菜和肉形石，這些文物在台北總是吸引遊客大排長龍。
董事長黃世惠強調這條航線的象徵意義。
2014 年，福岡的九州國立博物館成為日本第一個展出故宮文物的場館，是兩個鄰國文化交流的里程碑。
在商業上，這項合作遠不止於飛機本身。
包括模型飛機在內的聯名商品已開始販售，出示台灣虎航登機證的旅客可享故宮門票九折優惠。
這類合作有助於文化機構接觸更年輕及國際的觀眾。

maiden.en: first (used for a first journey or speech)
maiden.ex: The ship sank on its maiden voyage.

example.en: The new ferry completed its maiden voyage without problems.
example.zh: 這艘新渡輪順利完成了首航。

noteHi.exampleTr: नई नौका ने बिना समस्या के अपनी पहली यात्रा पूरी की।
noteHi.usage: केवल संज्ञा से पहले: maiden flight/voyage।

noteEs.exampleTr: El nuevo ferri completó su viaje inaugural sin problemas.
noteEs.usage: Solo antes del sustantivo: maiden flight/voyage.

noteJa.exampleTr: 新しいフェリーは問題なく処女航海を終えた。
noteJa.meaning: 初めての（航海・演説など）。

noteEn.meaning: first, used for a first journey or speech.
noteEn.usage: Only before a noun: "maiden flight", "maiden voyage".

master.en: a very skilled artist or person
master.ex: This painting is by a Dutch master.

masterpieces.en: the best and most famous works of art

example.en: The museum displays masterpieces from three dynasties.
example.zh: 這間博物館展出三個朝代的傑作。

note.usage: a masterpiece of + 類別；常與 true/great 連用。

noteHi.exampleTr: संग्रहालय तीन राजवंशों की उत्कृष्ट कृतियाँ दिखाता है।

noteEs.exampleTr: El museo exhibe obras maestras de tres dinastías.

noteJa.exampleTr: その博物館は三つの王朝の傑作を展示している。
noteJa.usage: a masterpiece of…、true masterpiece など。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 박물관은 세 왕조의 걸작을 전시한다.

noteEn.meaning: an extremely good piece of art or work.

meat-shaped.en: looking like a piece of meat; Meat-Shaped Stone = 肉形石

media.en: TV, radio, newspapers and the internet

merchandise.en: goods that are sold, often with a name or logo
merchandise.ex: The band sells merchandise after each show.

model.en: a small copy of an object such as a plane
model.ex: My son built a model of a ship.

models.ex: The shop sells models of trains.

moment.ex: It was a proud moment for the team.

morning.en: the early part of the day

mountains.ex: The mountains are covered in snow.

much-loved.en: liked very much by many people
much-loved.ex: The much-loved bakery closed last week.

museum.en: a building where old or important things are shown
museum.ex: The museum is free on Sundays.

national.ex: The national office is in Dublin.

neighbours.en: people or countries that are next to each other
neighbours.ex: Taiwan and Japan are close neighbours.

neo.en: part of the plane model name A320neo ("new engine option")

notably.ex: Notably, prices fell in rural areas.

noted.ex: She noted that prices had risen.

o'clock.ex: The shop opens at nine o'clock.

objects.en: things you can see and touch
objects.ex: Secure loose objects before the storm.

off.ex: All shoes are 20 percent off today.

old.ex: The old line closed in the 1970s.

on.ex: She wrote a report on the data breach.

operated.ex: The ferry operated only in summer.

out.en: used in phrasal verbs like watch out and point out

output.en: the work an artist or writer produces
output.ex: The writer's output was small but brilliant.

painted.ex: The report painted a grim picture of the economy.

painting.ex: There is a large painting above the sofa.

palace.en: a large, grand house of a king or queen; National Palace Museum = 故宮
palace.ex: The old palace is now a museum.

part.ex: A large part of the money went on rent.
part.zh: 部分（a large part of：大部分）

partnership.ex: The two firms formed a partnership.

partnerships.ex: The project is a partnership between two schools.

pass.en: a ticket or card that lets you go in; boarding pass = 登機證
pass.ex: Show your boarding pass at the gate.

peaks.ex: Snow covered the peaks this morning.

percent.ex: Ten percent of the class was absent.

pieces.en: single works of art or objects

planes.ex: Three planes landed in Shannon this morning.

pointed.en: pointed out: told people a fact they should notice
pointed.ex: She pointed out a mistake in the report.

popular.ex: The café is popular with students.

precious.ex: These old letters are precious to my family.

prefecture.en: a large area of local government in Japan
prefecture.ex: Kyoto Prefecture is famous for temples.

presenting.en: showing something such as a ticket or card
presenting.ex: Visitors presenting a student card pay less.

prominently.en: in a way that is easy to see or notice
prominently.ex: Her photo was prominently displayed on the front page.

example.en: Safety warnings are prominently displayed at the entrance.
example.zh: 安全警告醒目地張貼在入口處。

note.usage: feature/figure prominently 占重要地位；prominently displayed。

noteHi.exampleTr: सुरक्षा चेतावनियाँ प्रवेश द्वार पर प्रमुखता से लगी हैं।

noteEs.exampleTr: Los avisos de seguridad están expuestos de forma destacada en la entrada.

noteJa.exampleTr: 安全上の注意が入口に目立つように掲示されている。

noteKo.exampleTr: 안전 경고가 입구에 눈에 띄게 게시되어 있다.

noteEn.meaning: in a way that is easy to see or very important.

queues.ex: Ticket queues often open at nine in the morning.

reach.en: to get to a certain level
reach.ex: Prices could reach a new high.

realistic.en: looking very much like the real thing
realistic.ex: The painting of the fruit is very realistic.

receive.ex: You will receive a letter next week.

reduction.ex: There was a reduction in bus fares.

example.en: The old song still has resonance for young people.
example.zh: 這首老歌對年輕人仍有共鳴。

note.meaning: 共鳴；（對人的）感染力與意義。
note.usage: 常用 have/retain resonance、resonance for sb，指作品或想法仍能打動人。

noteHi.exampleTr: यह पुराना गीत आज भी युवाओं के दिल को छूता है।
noteHi.meaning: गूँज; लोगों को छूने वाली सार्थकता।

noteEs.exampleTr: La vieja canción todavía resuena entre los jóvenes.

noteJa.exampleTr: その古い歌は今も若者の心に響く。
noteJa.usage: have/retain resonance の形でよく使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 옛 노래는 여전히 젊은이들에게 울림을 준다.

noteEn.meaning: the power to touch people's feelings or thoughts.

route.en: the way a road or railway goes
route.ex: The bus route goes past the school.

sale.ex: The new phone goes on sale next week.

scale.en: scale model: an exact small copy made to size ratio
scale.ex: He built a scale model of the bridge.

scheduled.ex: The meeting is scheduled for Monday.

scroll.en: a long roll of paper or silk with writing or pictures
scroll.ex: The museum shows an ancient scroll.

selling.ex: The shop started selling coffee last year.

service.en: a regular flight, train or bus
service.ex: The airline starts a new service to Osaka.

show.ex: The figures show a big rise.

shows.ex: The mark shows the item is safe.

significance.ex: The significance of the vote is clear.

skies.ex: The skies were clear and dark.

souvenirs.en: things you buy to remember a place
souvenirs.ex: We bought souvenirs at the airport.

speaking.ex: Speaking on the radio, she defended the plan.

special.ex: The area has a special feeling.

stone.en: a rock; in an idiom meaning try everything
stone.ex: Police will leave no stone unturned in the search.
stone.ja: 石（あらゆる手を尽くす）
stone.zh: 石頭（leave no stone unturned：想盡辦法）

superimposed.en: placed on top of another image
superimposed.ex: The title was superimposed on a photo of the sea.

survive.ex: The shop may not survive the winter.

survived.ex: The old rule survived the changes.

surviving.en: still existing after a long time
surviving.ex: This is the oldest surviving map of the island.

symbolic.en: having a special meaning that represents something
symbolic.ex: The new bridge is a symbolic link between towns.

example.en: Planting the tree was a symbolic gesture of friendship.
example.zh: 種下這棵樹是象徵友誼的舉動。

note.usage: symbolic gesture/significance；be symbolic of 象徵…。

noteHi.exampleTr: पेड़ लगाना मित्रता का प्रतीकात्मक संकेत था।

noteEs.exampleTr: Plantar el árbol fue un gesto simbólico de amistad.

noteJa.exampleTr: 木を植えたのは友好の象徴的な行為だった。

noteKo.exampleTr: 나무를 심은 것은 우정의 상징적인 행동이었다.

noteEn.meaning: representing an idea rather than having practical value.

taiwan.en: an island country in East Asia

taken.zh: 飛上（taken to the skies）；開始
taken.es: alzado el vuelo (taken to the skies)
taken.en: taken to the skies: started flying
taken.ex: The new jet has taken to the skies.

taoyuan.en: a city in northern Taiwan with the main airport

themselves.en: without anyone doing it; on their own

there.ex: We lived there for five years.

this.en: the thing here or just said

ticket.en: a paper or card that lets you enter a place or travel

tie-up.en: a business partnership between two organisations
tie-up.ex: The two firms announced a tie-up last week.

time.en: an amount of minutes, days, etc.
time.ex: How much time do you need?

tour.en: a visit to see a place
tour.ex: We joined a tour of the factory.

uncannily.en: in a strange way that is hard to explain
uncannily.ex: The boy looks uncannily like his grandfather.

unusual.ex: It is unusual for the bank to speak during trading.

unveiled.en: shown to the public for the first time
unveiled.ex: A new statue was unveiled today.

venue.en: a place where an event happens

well.ex: The price is well above what we can pay.

went.ex: Prices went up in the summer.

which.en: used to add information about a thing

who.en: used to add information about a person

work.en: something made by an artist; also a job (work and classes = 上班上課)
work.ex: This painting is a work of art.

works.en: things made by an artist or writer
works.ex: Few of his works survive today.

wrapped.ex: The bus was wrapped in colourful adverts.

yuan-dynasty.en: from the Yuan dynasty of China (1271–1368)
